name: red-line-toolkit
description: The field guides from redlinedigital.dev — opinionated Claude Code pipelines for every change, high-rigor changes, page design, pre-ship audits, and session bookkeeping.

plugins.name: red-line-toolkit
plugins.description: 8 commands + 10 agents + the LedgerLoop ledger: start-session, end-session, cleanup-light, change-heavy, page-design, module-audit, mobile-audit and pre-commit-check, the-adjudicator, the module-audit fleet and the fable-seat audit agent. Install fable-seat-guard beside it.

plugins.name: fable-seat-guard
plugins.description: Companion to red-line-toolkit: puts every fable-seat subagent on a model family other than the orchestrator's, checks the model that actually started, and holds the seat to read-only tools.
